nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Ownable; set in constructor from _msgSender() and read by onlyOwner modifiers.
Mapping of account to reflection balances, mutated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve and consumed by transferFrom.
Blacklist mapping toggled by setBots/delBot and checked in _transfer.
Per-address cooldown timestamp mapping written in _transfer using block.timestamp.
Total reflection supply reduced in _reflectFee and read in _getCurrentSupply.
Fee recipient wallet 1, used as authorization gate in manualswap/manualsend and as ETH receiver in sendETHToFee.
Fee recipient wallet 2, ETH receiver in sendETHToFee.
Stored Uniswap V2 router interface assigned in openTrading and used for swaps/liquidity.
Liquidity pair address created in openTrading; used as a branch condition in _transfer.
Maximum transaction amount enforced by require inside _transfer.
Flag enabling automatic token-to-ETH swap within _transfer.
Reentrancy guard flag managed by the lockTheSwap modifier.
Flag toggled by setCooldownEnabled that enables the timestamp-based cooldown check.
Only-owner function that configures the router, creates the pair, adds liquidity and enables swap/cooldown; performs many external calls.
Core private transfer routine that sets fees, applies cooldown/maxTx/bots checks and triggers swap and ETH payout.
Private lockTheSwap function that approves the router and performs an external swap of tokens for ETH.
Private function that splits ETH and sends it to the two fee wallets via low-level transfer.
External function gated only by a msg.sender equality check against _feeAddrWallet1 that swaps contract tokens.
External function gated only by a msg.sender equality check against _feeAddrWallet1 that sends contract ETH to fee wallets.
Only-owner function that adds many addresses to the bots blacklist in a loop.
Public ERC20 transferFrom that calls _transfer and then reduces the allowance via _approve.
Public ERC20 transfer that invokes _transfer with msg.sender as source.
Public ERC20 approve delegating to _approve with msg.sender as owner.
Only-owner function that transfers ownership to the zero address.
Private function that moves reflection balances, charges team fees and reflects fees.
Private view converting a reflection amount to a token amount using the current rate.
Private view computing rSupply/tSupply rate from _getCurrentSupply.
Public view returning token balance derived from stored reflection balance.
Only-owner function toggling the cooldownEnabled flag.
Only-owner function removing an address from the bots blacklist.
Private function writing allowances after zero-address checks.
Private view computing reflection and token fee values from the current rate.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization comparisons and transfer sources.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for cooldown logic and swap/liquidity deadlines.
External call to the Uniswap router that sends tokens and can hand control to an attacker-controlled pair/token.
Native ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2 that forwards value after state changes.
Payable external call sending the whole contract ETH balance to the router during openTrading.
Source address parameter of _transfer.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Amount parameter of _transfer compared against _maxTxAmount.
Amount parameter of swapTokensForEth passed to the router swap.
Token amount parameter of _transferStandard fed into _getValues.
Local reflection amount computed in _transferStandard and subtracted from _rOwned[sender].

edges.reason: transfer() uses _msgSender() as the source of funds, so the caller controls the from address.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender when reducing the allowance.
manualswap authorizes with a raw msg.sender equality check instead of the onlyOwner modifier.
manualsend authorizes with a raw msg.sender equality check instead of the onlyOwner modifier.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 to grant privileged access.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 to grant privileged access.
The constructor and renounceOwnership write _owner from the caller-controlled sender.
renounceOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares _owner against _msgSender().
setCooldownEnabled is gated by onlyOwner on the _owner state variable.
delBot is gated by onlyOwner on the _owner state variable.
setBots is gated by onlyOwner on the _owner state variable.
openTrading is gated by onlyOwner and also uses owner() as the liquidity recipient.
block.timestamp is compared against and written into the cooldown mapping, creating timestamp dependency.
_transfer uses block.timestamp to gate the cooldown of the recipient.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the swap and liquidity deadline.
_transfer reads and writes cooldown[to] to enforce the timestamp-based limit.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount against the stored maximum.
_transfer reverts when bots[from] or bots[to] is set, acting as an owner-controlled blacklist.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth before finalizing the token transfer, creating a reentrancy path.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which forwards ETH to external wallets.
_transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transferStandard.
_transfer branches on whether from or to equals the uniswapV2Pair address.
openTrading writes the router interface into the uniswapV2Router state variable.
openTrading stores the pair returned by createPair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading forwards the full ETH balance to the router via addLiquidityETH.
openTrading approves the pair, enabling later token interactions with an external contract.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call that can re-enter the contract.
swapTokensForEth sets inSwap through the lockTheSwap modifier as a reentrancy guard.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to set the router allowance before swapping.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to the fee wallets through native transfers.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the ETH in sendETHToFee.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth on the whole contract token balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee on the whole contract ETH balance.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
transfer performs the token movement through _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping entry.
balanceOf converts the stored reflection balance using tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads the current rate from _getRate.
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal.
_getRate divides the reflection supply derived from _rTotal.
_transferStandard retrieves fee values from _getValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_transferStandard subtracts from and adds to the _rOwned reflection balances.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal after the transfer amounts are computed.
_transferStandard receives fee parameters prepared by _transfer via _tokenTransfer.
The from parameter feeds zero-address and bots checks inside _transfer.
The to parameter feeds zero-address, cooldown and bots checks inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount and forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
The tokenAmount parameter is passed to the router swap call.
The tAmount parameter is consumed by _getValues in _transferStandard.
The rAmount local is subtracted from _rOwned[sender] in _transferStandard.
